abilities.name: damp
abilities.effect: Prevents self destruct, explosion, and aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

abilities.name: cloud-nine
abilities.effect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

kanto.flavorText: Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.

original-johto.flavorText: It swims grace­ fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

hoenn.flavorText: A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: The flippers of its well-developed limbs give it shocking speed. It is the best swimmer among Pokémon.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

updated-johto.flavorText: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.

original-unova.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

updated-unova.flavorText: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

kalos.flavorText: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Golduck is the fastest swimmer among all Pokémon. It swims effortlessly, even in a rough, stormy sea. It sometimes rescues people from wrecked ships floundering in high seas.

original-alola.flavorText: It swims along the banks of lakes and catches fish Pokémon. It takes them to the shore and quietly eats them up.

updated-alola.flavorText: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Its long, slim limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.

swsh.flavorText: Old tales tell of Golduck punishing those that defiled its river. The guilty were dragged into the water and taken away.

pla.flavorText: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.
